purpose: sanitized public evidence for native app status semantics and official public pricing context

evidence.native_app_capability: FastVolt states that each charger displays its state in real time in the FastVolt experience.

evidence.scope_note: The public page presents these as general FastVolt parking/recharge prices. Station-specific applicability and any subscription interaction remain unverified, so this is tariff evidence rather than a station-level production tariff override.

github_runner_anonymous_raw_html.blocker_note: The two allowlisted GETs succeed, but the raw runner-visible HTML does not contain the rendered FAQ/pricing strings. Treat this as a client-rendering/static-HTML automation blocker, not as evidence that the public statements are absent.

modeling.app_source_access_network: FastVolt official mobile app / official public website
